value: Schedule the inspection online via the City's web-based inspection tracking system (account creation required), at least 24 hours in advance
Inspections are conducted 9:00 a.m. to noon and 1:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday through Thursday (no inspections on Fridays)
Keep the Building Inspection Record card and approved plans on the job site and available to the inspector at time of inspection
It is the permit holder's duty to notify the Building Division that work is ready and to provide the inspector proper access
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Inspections process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City's page does not describe a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.
